image_description: A group of four people posing for a portrait, wearing black academic regalia (gowns and mortarboard caps). The subjects are arranged in two rows. The person in the front right holds a diploma scroll. The person in the front left holds a white cane or staff. The background is a warm, textured studio backdrop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The garments are cropped at the waist or thighs due to the framing; full length to ankles is not visible.
The gowns clearly exhibit a vertical center-front opening and symmetrical drape on both sides of the torso.
The fabric hangs loosely, hiding the specific shape of the arms and torso underneath.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject on the right displays the characteristic bell-shaped sleeve that extends significantly past the wrist/hand.
Distinct vertical panels are visible along the front opening of the gowns.
Collared shirts and ties are visible at the neck openings of the gowns.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears opaque, heavy, and non-reflective, consistent with academic robe materials.
Lighting on the folds shows diffuse reflection rather than specular highlights, indicating a matte finish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Confirmed on the rightmost subject; the sleeve hangs lower than the hand holding the diploma.

artifact_observations.location: Hands of the front-left subject holding the white staff
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers appear fused and malformed, lacking distinct digit separation. The grip on the staff looks physically impossible with merged anatomy.
Skin texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking natural pore detail. Teeth appear slightly irregular and 'mushy' rather than distinct structures.
The geometry of the caps is inconsistent; some brims warp unnaturally, and the tassels attach at ambiguous points without clear physics.

To analyze the severity of the plastic skin texture and malformed hands observed in the initial scan.

focus_areas: Hand anatomy and finger separation (especially holding objects)
Gown sleeve geometry and drape physics
Edge sharpness between black fabric and background
